name: External Cancellation Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the cancellation reason, as published in an external cancellation reason code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

AC02.name: Invalid Debtor Account Number
AC02.definition: Debtor account number invalid or missing.

AC03.name: Invalid Creditor Account Number
AC03.definition: Wrong account number in Credit Transfer.

AGNT.name: Incorrect Agent
AGNT.definition: Agent in the payment workflow is incorrect.

AM09.name: Wrong Amount
AM09.definition: Amount is not the amount agreed or expected.

BE16.name: Invalid Debtor Identification Code
BE16.definition: Debtor or Ultimate Debtor identification code missing or invalid.

COVR.name: Cover Cancelled Or Returned
COVR.definition: Cover payments has either been returned or cancelled.

CURR.name: Incorrect Currency
CURR.definition: Currency of the payment is incorrect.

CUTA.name: Cancel Upon Unable To Apply
CUTA.definition: Cancellation requested because an investigation request has been received and no remediation is possible.

DS24.name: Time Out
DS24.definition: Cancellation requested because the original payment order expired due to time-out.

DT01.name: Invalid Date
DT01.definition: Invalid date (for example, wrong or missing settlement date).

DUPL.name: Duplicate Payment
DUPL.definition: Payment is a duplicate of another payment.

FRAD.name: Fraudulent Origin
FRAD.definition: Cancellation requested following a transaction that was originated fraudulently. The use of the FraudulentOrigin code should be governed by jurisdictions.

FRNA.name: Forward To Next Agent
FRNA.definition: To complement a rejection response, suggesting the request for cancelation should be forwarded to the next agent in the payment transaction chain.

FRTR.name: Final Response
FRTR.definition: Direct Debit Tracking recalled as Mandate Cancelled.

INDM.name: Indemnity Required
INDM.definition: To express the wish to establish a bilateral indemnity agreement.

MODT.name: Modified Transaction
MODT.definition: The underlying transaction in relation to an RTP was modified.

PAID.name: Transaction Already Paid
PAID.definition: The underlying transaction in relation to an RTP was already paid (via other means).

SVNR.name: Service Not Rendered
SVNR.definition: The payment is cancelled since a cash amount rendered was not correct or goods or a service was not rendered to the customer, e.g. in an e-commerce situation.

SYAD.name: Request To Settlement System Administrator
SYAD.definition: Cancellation requested by System Member to Settlement System Administrator to indicate that the cancellation request must not be forwarded further in the chain.

TECH.name: Technical Problem
TECH.definition: Cancellation requested following technical problems resulting in an erroneous transaction.

ENUE.name: End User Error
ENUE.definition: Cancellation or request for return requested by the Debtor specifically due to one or more errors by debtor in the original Credit Transfer. Usage: This code can be used for any error in the original Credit Transfer made by the Debtor. Can also be used if multiple errors were made in the original Credit Transfer.

UAPA.name: Unauthorized Payment
UAPA.definition: The Debtor is requesting a return of the payment because the payment was not properly authorized.|Usage: This code can be used in the case where a Credit Transfer was made without proper authorization from the Debtor. This could be due to compromised end user credentials.

NARR.name: Narrative
NARR.definition: Reason is provided as narrative information in the additional reason information.

INCR.name: Invalid Cancellation Request
INCR.definition: Process a cancellation request with incorrect reference to original batch.

BIAS.name: Batch Instruction Already Settled
BIAS.definition: Process a cancellation request but batch already settled.

WNTB.name: Warranty Breach
WNTB.definition: Breach of warranty provided in connection with a request for payment.

MD06.name: Refund Request By End Customer
MD06.definition: Return of funds requested by end customer.

PPRC.name: Payee Participant RTP Cancellation
PPRC.definition: Request to Pay cancellation initiated because the Payee is not in good standing.

ECAG.name: Error Creditor Agent
ECAG.definition: Payee (Creditor) cancels the Request To Pay (RTP) request due to error or adjustment agreement with Payer/Debtor.

NFNA.name: Never Forward To Next Agent
NFNA.definition: To complement a cancellation request, instructing the market infrastructure that the request for cancelation should not be forwarded to the next agent in the payment transaction chain.
